description: Test suite for absl::string_view, including constructors, comparison operators, find methods, substrings, and constexpr support.

classes.name: Mallocator
classes.description: A minimal allocator that uses malloc() and free() for memory management.

methods.name: StringViewTest.Ctor
methods.description: Tests various constructors of absl::string_view, including default, from const char*, from std::string, and with custom allocators.

methods.name: StringViewTest.Swap
methods.description: Tests the swap functionality of absl::string_view.

methods.name: StringViewTest.STLComparator
methods.description: Tests comparison operators and map insertion with absl::string_view keys.

methods.name: StringViewTest.ComparisonOperators
methods.description: Tests comparison operators (==, !=, <, <=, >, >=) between string_view instances.

methods.name: StringViewTest.ComparisonOperatorsByCharacterPosition
methods.description: Tests comparison operators by character position differences.

methods.name: StringViewTest.NposMatchesStdStringView
methods.description: Verifies that absl::string_view::npos matches std::string::npos.

methods.name: StringViewTest.STL1
methods.description: Tests element access, size, empty, copy, and exception behavior.

methods.name: StringViewTest.STL2
methods.description: Tests find, rfind, and find_last_of methods.

methods.name: StringViewTest.STL2FindFirst
methods.description: Tests find_first_of and find_first_not_of methods.

methods.name: StringViewTest.STL2FindLast
methods.description: Tests find_last_of and find_last_not_of methods.

methods.name: StringViewTest.STL2Substr
methods.description: Tests substr method with various parameters.

methods.name: StringViewTest.TruncSubstr
methods.description: Tests the ClippedSubstr utility for truncating substrings.

methods.name: StringViewTest.UTF8
methods.description: Tests UTF-8 string handling within string_view.

methods.name: StringViewTest.FindConformance
methods.description: Verifies that find, rfind, and related methods conform to expected behavior.

methods.name: StringViewTest.Remove
methods.description: Tests remove_prefix and remove_suffix methods.

methods.name: StringViewTest.Set
methods.description: Tests setting string_view to different strings.

methods.name: StringViewTest.FrontBack
methods.description: Tests front() and back() element access.

methods.name: StringViewTest.FrontBackSingleChar
methods.description: Tests front() and back() with single-character string_view.

methods.name: StringViewTest.FrontBackEmpty
methods.description: Ensures front() and back() are not called on empty string_view in debug mode.

methods.name: StringViewTest.NULLInput
methods.description: Tests behavior when constructing string_view from nullptr.

methods.name: StringViewTest.Comparisons2
methods.description: Tests various compare overloads and string_view vs std::string comparisons.

methods.name: StringViewTest.At
methods.description: Tests the at() method for element access with bounds checking.

methods.name: StringViewTest.ExplicitConversionOperator
methods.description: Tests explicit conversion from string_view to std::string.

methods.name: StringViewTest.NullSafeStringView
methods.description: Tests the NullSafeStringView utility for nullptr safety.

methods.name: StringViewTest.ConstexprNullSafeStringView
methods.description: Tests constexpr support for NullSafeStringView.

methods.name: StringViewTest.ConstexprCompiles
methods.description: Verifies various constexpr operations on string_view.

methods.name: StringViewTest.Noexcept
methods.description: Checks that various string_view methods are noexcept.

methods.name: StringViewTest.BoundsCheck
methods.description: Ensures bounds checking in debug mode for front/back element access.

methods.name: StringViewTest.NonNegativeLen
methods.description: Tests that string_view construction enforces non-negative length.

methods.name: StringViewTest.LenExceedsMaxSize
methods.description: Tests that length exceeding max_size triggers assertion.

methods.name: StringViewStreamTest.Pad
methods.description: Utility for padding strings for stream tests.

methods.name: StringViewStreamTest.ResetsWidth
methods.description: Tests that stream width resets after formatting.
